package.name: ScanRuler for FreeCAD
package.description: ScanRuler's scan measuring (fits, alignment, deviation, wall thickness, sections, mesh tools, reverse engineering) and its plugins (scanner noise, thread match, wear repair, print fit from a scan, parts catalog, assembly manual, library pack), ported from ScanRuler by Stefan Hermann (CNC Kitchen): a ScanRuler workbench of its own, and tools for agents through Agent Link for FreeCAD when it is installed. An independent port, not made or endorsed by CNC Kitchen; not affiliated with or endorsed by the FreeCAD project or the FPA.

workbench.name: ScanRuler
workbench.description: ScanRuler's workspaces for a 3D scan: 3D Measure, Surface Deviation, Wall Thickness, 2D Measure, Mesh Tools and Reverse Engineer, after ScanRuler by Stefan Hermann (CNC Kitchen).
